correctness.rationale: Explicit stationary ON/OFF elimination reduces six equations to a resolvent on three ON states; symbolic elimination gives the exact factored current, independently checked against 60 rational full generators. Positivity of A,B,C follows from symmetric polynomials in positive weights; exact derivative yields unique optimizer and inequalities \(3/2<s_*<3\), with constructive sharp limits. Finite tests supplement a general algebraic proof.

originality.rationale: The exact six-state rate convention is credited to its inspected 2010 exposition. Comparison of complete Roldán–Parrondo and Seifner relevant sections finds no arbitrary-weight Vandermonde stationary flux, all-s switching sign rigidity, or a sharp universal 3/2-to-3 optimizer; the closest general switched-cycle theorem permits current reversals and does not imply this subclass result. An inaccessible plausible switched-sawtooth paper remains a stated originality risk, so originality is not a claim of exhaustive uniqueness.

value.rationale: The three-state flashing ratchet is a standard elementary nonequilibrium motor, and switching-rate optimization is a natural transport design problem. The theorem gives a global no-current-reversal classification and universal sharp optimizer interval for a continuum of asymmetric potentials, rather than a parameter-specific calculation.
